masterpages.title: Negative Rewrite
masterpages.summary: An operation where a state or timeline is rewritten, and the rewrite itself retroactively removes its own surviving causal provenance so tha...
source_canon: An operation where a state or timeline is rewritten, and the rewrite itself retroactively removes its own surviving causal provenance so that it was never caused as a rewrite.
masterpages.explanation: Unlike standard timeline alterations that leave an active rewritelog or paradox trace, Negative Rewrite erases the fact that an alteration occurred. The modified state appears as having always been the natural state.
masterpages.commonly_confused_with: Hypernegative Rewrite (Negative Rewrite handles first-order provenance; Hypernegative handles infinite explanatory orders).

masterpages.title: Hypernegative Rewrite
masterpages.summary: An update implemented across the fundamental structures of reality where if the reason why a cause is not a rewrite would itself be a rewrit...
source_canon: An update implemented across the fundamental structures of reality where if the reason why a cause is not a rewrite would itself be a rewrite, that reason is conceptually rewritten so that it was never a rewrite, applying recursively across every explanatory order without terminal depth.
masterpages.explanation: Produces absolute rewrite-originlessness. The resulting effect X remains real and permanent, while no causal, reasonal, metacausal, metareasonal, or recursively higher explanatory path can truthfully terminate in or derive its rewrite status from a rewrite.
masterpages.commonly_confused_with: Mere memory wiping or simple timeline branching.

masterpages.title: Parahistory
masterpages.summary: The total causal-derivational structure of rewrites affecting a subject or domain, including every rewrite of any kind and every higher-orde...
source_canon: The total causal-derivational structure of rewrites affecting a subject or domain, including every rewrite of any kind and every higher-order rewrite causally responsible for producing, modifying, replacing, retrocausing, beginninglessifying, or determining another rewrite.
masterpages.explanation: Parahistory is a multi-dimensional directed acyclic graph (or hypergraph) of rewrites. A beginningless history can itself possess a higher-order parahistorical cause that caused that history to have never had a beginning.
formalization: Parahistory(S) = { (R_i, R_j) | R_i causally produces or alters R_j on domain S }
masterpages.commonly_confused_with: Linear timeline or historical chronicle.

masterpages.title: Paratime
masterpages.summary: The causal ordering dimension in which timelines are ordered by which timeline causes another timeline. Earlier paratemporal entries cause l...
source_canon: The causal ordering dimension in which timelines are ordered by which timeline causes another timeline. Earlier paratemporal entries cause later entries, and later entries are caused by earlier entries. The Arthitean Empire exists outside paratime while existing in time.
masterpages.explanation: The Empire possesses internal time (past, present, future) without being a sequence of paratemporal versions. A single pantemporal Hypernegative Rewrite establishes invariants across all Empire time simultaneously.
formalization: T_a ≺_paratime T_b ⇔ T_a causally produces T_b; Empire ∈ Time ∧ Empire ∉ Paratime
masterpages.commonly_confused_with: Multiverse parallel dimensions.

masterpages.title: Acausality
masterpages.summary: The absolute property of lacking an antecedent cause or origin-event in the causal sequence....
source_canon: The absolute property of lacking an antecedent cause or origin-event in the causal sequence.
masterpages.explanation: Acausality establishes that a state or entity is uncaused. It does not automatically imply hyperacausality or transrecursive hypercausality.
masterpages.commonly_confused_with: Antiprecausality (Antiprecausality means nothing precedes S; acausality means nothing causes S).

masterpages.title: Hyperacausality
masterpages.summary: The state where the acausality of something itself lacks any cause or reason explaining why or how it is acausal....
source_canon: The state where the acausality of something itself lacks any cause or reason explaining why or how it is acausal.
masterpages.explanation: Closes the second-order causal loophole where an opponent argues: 'Entity X is acausal, but I caused it to be acausal, so I control it.' Hyperacausality removes the cause of the acausality.
masterpages.commonly_confused_with: Standard first-order acausality.

masterpages.title: Antiprecausality
masterpages.summary: Antiprecausal means that nothing precedes the subject in any sequence of causality or metacausality. Parahistorologically Antiprecausal mean...
source_canon: Antiprecausal means that nothing precedes the subject in any sequence of causality or metacausality. Parahistorologically Antiprecausal means nothing precedes the subject in its parahistory.
masterpages.explanation: Predecessorlessness in sequence order. An entity can be antiprecausal (first in line) while still having non-preceding ontological grounds, which is why acausality is distinct and complementary.
masterpages.commonly_confused_with: Acausality.

masterpages.title: Supracause & Asupracausal

source_canon: Supracause means a cause for a reason for something. Asupracausal means lacking a cause for a reason for something. Supracausality is the causality of the acausality of something.
masterpages.explanation: Governs the interface between abstract reasons and concrete causal mechanisms.
masterpages.commonly_confused_with: Infracausality.

masterpages.title: Infracausality & Infracause

source_canon: Infracausality is the acausality of the causality of something. An infracause is the foundational non-contingent root underlying a causal mechanism.
masterpages.explanation: Where causality operates as a function, infracausality denotes that the function itself operates without causal antecedents.
masterpages.commonly_confused_with: Supracausality.

masterpages.title: Transrecursive Hypercausality

masterpages.explanation: The absolute peak of causal independence in the Arthitean Codex. Closes all meta-theoretical regresses across causality, metacausality, reasonal logic, and parahistorical derivation.
masterpages.commonly_confused_with: Simple omnipotence or ungrounded existence.

source_canon: The formal causal mechanics where the ontological invariance of an effect (E) retrocausally forces the negation of any potential cause (¬C) that would prevent E, and necessitates the existence of any prerequisite (P) required for E.
masterpages.explanation: Based on classical Modus Tollens (P => Q ⊢ ¬Q => ¬P). If Imperial victory is invariant (V = TRUE), then any attack A that entails ¬V is rendered counterfactually impossible and neutralized at the root.
masterpages.commonly_confused_with: Conventional fate or destiny (Modus-Tollens causality is active ontological enforcement, not passive prophecy).

masterpages.explanation: CRITICAL CANON DISTINCTION: Supramajor DOES acquire new blessings. It is retroactive. It scales QUALITY, distinct from strength.
masterpages.commonly_confused_with: Strength enhancement (Supramajor governs retroactive acquisition and quality, not strength).

masterpages.title: Pressurised-Hyperenlightenment
masterpages.summary: A Supramajor breakthrough in Enlightenment that scales higher in countersurpassableness of Unprecedentedness of groundbreakingness when unde...
source_canon: A Supramajor breakthrough in Enlightenment that scales higher in countersurpassableness of Unprecedentedness of groundbreakingness when under greater pressure. In Rhayhara, causes brightly glowing eyes and temporarily fiery hair.
masterpages.explanation: Possesses all Supramajor properties: retroactively acquires new blessings with Toren-indexed quality.
masterpages.commonly_confused_with: Cosmetic super-state (The physical glowing/fiery manifestation accompanies profound retroactive ontological acquisition).

source_canon: Anticipatory biological, psychological, and physiological adaptation developed during the ancient standoff between rival Arthratan thrones and dynasties.
masterpages.explanation: Arthitean physiology adapts preemptively to counter hostile biological and conceptual vectors before they are deployed in open warfare.
masterpages.commonly_confused_with: Reactive immunity (It is anticipatory and strategic, not merely reactive antibodies).

source_canon: The elite Arthitean martial-adaptive lineage discipline specializing in physiological resistance, deep unstressableness, and recursive hardening under extreme environmental duress.
masterpages.explanation: Integrates directly with zirunstressableness: extreme training becomes exponentially optimal.
masterpages.commonly_confused_with: Ordinary martial arts.

masterpages.title: Hyperclan 1 & 2 (Varvadeil Clan)
masterpages.summary: Specialized Arthitean clan organizations (specifically the Varvadeil Clan under Asmouth Varvadeil) dedicated to creating, incorporating, and...
source_canon: Specialized Arthitean clan organizations (specifically the Varvadeil Clan under Asmouth Varvadeil) dedicated to creating, incorporating, and maintaining biological and brain-lobe factors that feed recursively into PHK.
masterpages.explanation: Ensures that every new mental lobe or physiological trait establishes a positive recursive feedback loop with the PHK engine.
masterpages.commonly_confused_with: Political factions (Hyperclans are genetic and physiological feedback engineering bodies).

masterpages.title: Archarthitean Factor

source_canon: A factor in the PHK loop; Toren of Pressurised-Enlightenment for increasing Bloodline Blessing strength per willpower used at the time the Pressurised-Enlightenment occurred.
masterpages.explanation: NON-NEGOTIABLE CANON RULE: Does NOT acquire new bloodline blessings. Scales strength of existing/retroacquired blessings by willpower at occurrence.
masterpages.commonly_confused_with: New blessing grant (Archarthitean factor exclusively strengthens; Supramajor acquires).

masterpages.title: Arthitean Deity Factors One & Two
masterpages.summary: Factor One is Toren of Pressurised-Hyperenlightenment for increasing Bloodline Blessing strength per willpower at occurrence. Factor Two is ...
source_canon: Factor One is Toren of Pressurised-Hyperenlightenment for increasing Bloodline Blessing strength per willpower at occurrence. Factor Two is Pressurised-Hyperenlightenment for Arthitean Deity Factor One, functioning as a recursive meta-amplifier within the PHK loop.
masterpages.explanation: Factor One scales strength. Factor Two applies Pressurised-Hyperenlightenment directly to Factor One, creating stress-amplified exponential meta-recursion.
formalization: Factor_One = Toren(PH) × Willpower; Factor_Two = PH(Factor_One) ⟹ Exponential Loop Feedback
masterpages.commonly_confused_with: Simple duplicate buffs (Factor Two is a meta-operator acting directly upon Factor One).
